names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Μαΐου, «Αγία Γλυκερία του Νόβγκοροντ», with the rank word and the city left off.

Read out of the heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name link 2446 and of both her life pages, «Святая праведная Гликерия, дева Новгородская», with the rank words «Святая праведная» and the word «дева» left off — no stored Russian form in this corpus carries «дева», and the grade is in `types` instead. The day's own line declines her «Прав. Гликерии девы, Новгородской (1522).» `fk.mjs` on «Гликерия Новгородская» returned NONE before the write.

death.note: saint.gr: «έζησε κατά τον 15ο και 16ο αιώνα μ.Χ.… Η Αγία κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1522 μ.Χ.», and its head line reads «Αγια Γλυκερια Του Νοβγκοροντ (; - 1522)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 мая ст. ст. — «Прав. Гликерии девы, Новгородской (1522).»

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Greek, the same year, 1522, and the same woman: the virgin of Novgorod whose incorrupt body was found by the church of the martyrs Флор and Лавр. The Russian gives her a father and a street — daughter of Пантелеймон, the elder of the Легощая street in Novgorod — which the Greek page did not. **`dates` were not touched, and the two Russian life pages disagree about the finding of the relics.** The shorter, life1056, has them found «14 июля 1572 года», fifty years after her death, and quotes the Second Novgorod Chronicle; the fuller, life6536, prints «14 июля 1522 года ... через 50 лет после кончины» and then quotes the Novgorod chronicle **under 1572** two sentences later, so its 1522 is a slip for 1572 inside its own paragraph. Neither is the year the folder carries, which is her repose; both readings are in the life and nothing was changed. **One hymn was copied**, the troparion the day page prints «праведной Гликерии девы, Новгородской»; its last word is printed «спастйся» on the page and is copied as printed. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαΐου — «Αγία Γλυκερία του Νόβγκοροντ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **She is neither of the corpus's two Glycerias**, and this is the one real identity question of the day, read both ways: the corpus's [Glyceria of Traianopolis](/saints/glyceria-of-traianopolis) is the second-century martyr whom saint.gr also keeps on this same 13 May with a page of her own, and Glyceria of Adrianople is a martyr kept on 22 October, while this one is the daughter of Panteleimon, a municipal officer of Novgorod, who died in peace in 1522 — a different millennium and a peaceful death. **The page's own footer links a separate commemoration of the finding of her relics**, «Ανακομιδή Ιερών Λειψάνων της Αγίας Γλυκερίας του Νόβγκοροντ», which was not read and is not recorded as a feast here; the finding is dated 14 July 1572 in the body of this page. **`righteous` and `virgin` are in `types`** on the page's peaceful death and on its silence about any marriage or monastic habit; if `virgin` reads as more than the page says, it is the one word in this folder to strike. **No `locations` object.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

hymns.text: Вышния красоты желающи,/ нижния сласти телесныя далече от себе отринула еси/ и, нестяжание паче суетнаго мира возлюбивши,/ ангельское житие провождала еси, Гликерие, дево блаженная,/ моли Христа Бога спастйся душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 мая ст. ст. — «Тропарь праведной Гликерии девы, Новгородской»; the last word is printed «спастйся» on the page and is copied as printed

english.text: Desiring the beauty on high, thou didst cast far from thee the lower sweetness of the body; and loving poverty above the vain world, thou didst pass thy days in an angelic life, O blessed virgin Glyceria. Pray to Christ God for the salvation of our souls.
